A day for each feast

Nowruz

Nowruz: Celebrating Persian New Year and Spring Renewal

Nowruz marks the Persian New Year and the arrival of spring, a time to refresh the home, honor loved ones, and enjoy traditional foods that celebrate renewal and growth.

  1. Morning

    Spring Cleaning and Setting the Haft-Seen Table

    Begin the day by thoroughly cleaning your home to welcome freshness and renewal. Then, set the Haft-Seen table with seven symbolic items that represent health, prosperity, and rebirth.

  2. Late Morning

    Prepare Celebratory Rice

    Cook a fragrant, herb-forward celebratory rice dish to honor the season’s bounty and prepare for the festive meal ahead.

    Recipes: Celebratory Rice

  3. Noon

    Enjoy a Family Lunch

    Gather with family to share the celebratory rice along with fresh herbs and seasonal vegetables, symbolizing growth and health.

    Recipes: Celebratory Rice

  4. Afternoon

    Visit Loved Ones

    Spend time visiting family and friends to exchange well wishes for the new year and strengthen community bonds.

  5. Late Afternoon

    Serve Tea and Sweets

    Offer traditional tea and sweets to guests as a warm gesture of hospitality and celebration.

    Recipes: Traditional Brewed Tea · Persian Sweets for Nowruz

  6. Evening

    Reflect and Celebrate Renewal

    End the day by reflecting on the themes of renewal and hope that Nowruz embodies, enjoying the company of loved ones.

May the spirit of Nowruz bring you peace, prosperity, and a joyful new beginning.
